# Renox

> Renox is a batteries-included Rust web framework inspired by Laravel: Axum + HTMX + Alpine.js,
> with SQLite by default or PostgreSQL (the `postgres` feature). Apps depend on the `renox` crate
> and are managed with the `rnx` CLI. To do something the idiomatic way, open the one file listed
> for it below rather than reading the framework's source.

## Start here

- [CHEATSHEET.md](CHEATSHEET.md): the common patterns, 5–20 lines each and compiled as doctests
  (routes, views, forms and validation, models and queries, pagination, auth and policies, HTMX, raw
  SQL and transactions, jobs, events, schedule, mail, cache, session, uploads, translations, tests,
  `.env`).
- [README.md](README.md): install `rnx`, create and run an app, the generator commands.

## Examples (complete apps, tested in CI)

- [examples/crud](examples/crud): one resource end to end: model and migration, list with
  pagination, create and edit forms with validation, owner-only edit and delete through a policy,
  soft delete with a trash and restore, flash messages, and tests for each.
  - Routes and handlers: [examples/crud/src/app/products/mod.rs](examples/crud/src/app/products/mod.rs)
  - Model, factory, policy: [model.rs](examples/crud/src/app/products/model.rs),
    [policy.rs](examples/crud/src/app/products/policy.rs)
  - Views: [index.html](examples/crud/resources/views/products/index.html),
    [form.html](examples/crud/resources/views/products/form.html)
  - Tests: [examples/crud/tests/products.rs](examples/crud/tests/products.rs)
- [examples/hello](examples/hello): a guestbook in one file: HTMX form posts that return
  fragments, a photo upload, an event whose listener queues a mail job, a scheduled task,
  i18n (en/id) with a language switch, and a seeder.
  - [examples/hello/src/lib.rs](examples/hello/src/lib.rs),
    [tests](examples/hello/tests/guestbook.rs)

## Guides

- [docs/postgresql.md](docs/postgresql.md): PostgreSQL apps, migrations per database, SQL that runs
  on both, tests with `TEST_DATABASE_URL`, moving data from SQLite.
- `rnx make:deploy` writes `deploy/README.md` (Docker, systemd, Litestream backups).

## Where things are (for changing Renox itself)

- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md) (same as AGENTS.md): the contributor and agent guide, including the
  architecture, conventions, and problems already solved.
- [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md): milestones and design decisions.
- `crates/renox-core/src`: the runtime. `db/` (Db, models, queries, migrations), `validation/`,
  `auth/`, `queue/`, `schedule.rs`, `view.rs`, `testing.rs`.
- `crates/renox-cli`: `rnx`; `stubs/` holds the files `rnx new` writes.
